items.title: Glover Compton Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: And Frank Preyer run the Deluxe, by the way I tell you.

ctx.x: Did the gangsters control the dance halls? Who ran the E-Light in all those places?
Art Cardoza and Tina and Jones run the E-Light. Bill Bottoms run the Dreamlin. And Frank Preyer run the Deluxe, by the way I tell you.
Were most of those people colored? Colored, yes.
